props.headline: Frost delay until eight.
props.emphasis: Every member heard before they left home.
props.body: Decided on the morning of play, sent the way each member chose to hear from the club.

caption:
Frost delays are decided on the morning of play, by people looking at the course that day. There is no way to know the night before.

That makes the update a race against the commute. The club that reaches every member before they leave home saves a lot of people a wasted drive, and saves the staff the conversation that follows.

The decision stays with the superintendent. The job of club communication is getting it out fast.
firstComment: Members each have a preference for hearing about this: some want a text, some check email, some open the app. The update should meet each of them where they already look.
altText: Photograph of a golf course at dawn with mist in the trees, with the eyebrow Course update and the headline Frost delay until eight. Every member heard before they left home. Body: decided on the morning of play, sent the way each member chose to hear from the club.
earnsItsPlace: Shows the same-morning course update from the operator's side, the notification job Club Pilot does across channels; a course account would post the delay, not how every member hears it.
